recon_and_setup.description: Initial reconnaissance, device identification, and environment preparation for Android security testing.

commands.description: Enumerate all connected Android devices via ADB.
Get full device info — Android version, model, build, security patch level.
Check if device is rooted — detect su binary, Magisk, SuperSU.
commands.command: adb shell 'which su; ls /system/xbin/su /system/bin/su /sbin/su 2>/dev/null; getprop ro.build.tags; ls /data/local/tmp/magisk* 2>/dev/null'

commands.description: List all installed packages (apps) on the device.
List all installed packages including system apps with installer info.
Dump complete device info for attack surface mapping.
commands.command: adb shell dumpsys package > package_dump.txt && adb shell dumpsys activity > activity_dump.txt

recon_and_setup.prerequisites: ADB installed; target device or emulator; physical/network access
recon_and_setup.opsec: Physical access for USB ADB is reliable. Network ADB (port 5555) accessible if enabled by malware or developer mode. Enumerate device info before deeper testing.
recon_and_setup.detection_ref: USB debugging authorization prompt; MDM device policies; ADB network port scanning detection

apk_extraction.description: Extracting APK files from devices and online sources for static analysis.

commands.description: Find APK path for a specific installed package.
Pull APK from device to local machine.
commands.command: adb pull $(adb shell pm path {package_name} | cut -d: -f2 | tr -d '\r') {output.apk}

commands.description: Extract split APKs (App Bundles) from device.
commands.command: adb shell pm path {package_name}; adb pull /data/app/{package_name}-*/base.apk base.apk; adb pull /data/app/{package_name}-*/split_config.*.apk .

commands.description: Download APK directly from Google Play without device using APKPure CLI.
Bulk extract all user-installed APKs from device.
commands.command: for pkg in $(adb shell pm list packages -3 | cut -d: -f2 | tr -d '\r'); do path=$(adb shell pm path $pkg | cut -d: -f2 | tr -d '\r'); adb pull $path ${pkg}.apk; done

apk_extraction.prerequisites: ADB access to device; app installed on device
apk_extraction.opsec: Extract APK without root via adb backup or pm path. Root allows direct APK access. Extracted APK enables static analysis without device interaction.
apk_extraction.detection_ref: MDM application control; certificate pinning in apps; adb backup disabled by MDM

static_analysis.description: Decompiling, disassembling, and statically analyzing Android APKs for vulnerabilities and secrets.

commands.description: Decompile APK to Smali bytecode with apktool.
Decompile APK to Java source code with jadx.
Launch jadx GUI for interactive Java source exploration.
Search decompiled source for hardcoded secrets, API keys, and passwords.
Inspect AndroidManifest.xml for exported components, permissions, and attack surface.
Find all exported Activities, Services, Receivers, and Providers.
Extract all URLs and endpoints from APK source.
Run automated static analysis with MobSF.
Check network security config for cleartext and pinning bypass opportunities.
Scan APK for known vulnerable libraries with OWASP dependency check.

static_analysis.prerequisites: APK file; jadx, apktool, MobSF; analysis environment
static_analysis.opsec: Static analysis is fully offline — no interaction with target systems. Decompile with jadx for Java source, apktool for resources and smali.
static_analysis.detection_ref: APK obfuscation (ProGuard/R8); code encryption; anti-tampering detection in apps; Play Protect scanning

commands.description: List running processes on device via Frida.

dynamic_analysis_setup.prerequisites: Rooted device or emulator; Frida server; Burp Suite/Frida; adb access
dynamic_analysis_setup.opsec: Emulators detected by many apps via Build.FINGERPRINT. Use real rooted device for advanced testing. Xposed Framework for non-Frida hooking.
dynamic_analysis_setup.detection_ref: Root detection; emulator detection; developer mode restrictions; Play Integrity API (SafetyNet replacement)

ssl_pinning_bypass.detection_ref: Root detection; SSL pinning implementation; Play Integrity API; certificate transparency monitoring

traffic_interception.prerequisites: Proxy configured (Burp); device trust anchor for proxy cert; SSL pinning bypassed
traffic_interception.opsec: Install Burp CA as system cert for older Android (<7.0). Android 7+ requires pinning bypass or network security config override. Use Frida for runtime bypass.
traffic_interception.detection_ref: SSL pinning; certificate transparency; Play Integrity API; network security config enforcement

insecure_data_storage.opsec: World-readable files in app directories are immediately exploitable. SharedPreferences in XML format often store tokens unencrypted.
insecure_data_storage.detection_ref: Android Keystore System for credential storage; EncryptedSharedPreferences; file permission auditing; OWASP Mobile Top 10 testing

frida_runtime_hooks.detection_ref: Anti-tampering checks for frida-server process; code integrity verification; Frida detection libraries (FridaGuard)

android_backup_abuse.description: Exploit Android backup functionality — extract app data via ADB backup on apps with android:allowBackup=true, and tamper with restored data.

commands.description: Check if target app allows backup (allowBackup=true in manifest)
Create full ADB backup of target application
Convert ADB backup to TAR for analysis with Android Backup Extractor
commands.command:
java -jar abe.jar unpack backup.ab backup.tar
tar xvf backup.tar

commands.description: Find credentials in extracted backup data
Tamper with backup data and restore to device
commands.command:
# Modify database or shared_prefs file
tar cf modified_backup.tar apps/
java -jar abe.jar pack modified_backup.tar modified_backup.ab
adb restore modified_backup.ab

android_backup_abuse.prerequisites: ADB access; target app with android:allowBackup=true in manifest
android_backup_abuse.opsec: adb backup extracts app data for apps with allowBackup=true. No root required. Backup contains databases, shared preferences, files.
android_backup_abuse.detection_ref: android:allowBackup=false in manifest for sensitive apps; adb backup MDM restriction; backup encryption enforcement

deeplink_uri_scheme_attacks.opsec: Deep link parameter injection for open redirect or authentication bypass. Mobile browsers and apps follow deep links automatically.
